chain.g: third degree or note of Guido of Arezzo's hexachordal scales

ety.text: From Glover's solmization, from Middle English mi (“third degree or note of Guido of Arezzo's hexachordal scales”), Italian mi in the solmization of Guido of Arezzo, from the first syllable of Latin mīra (“miracles; the miraculous”) in the lyrics of the scale-ascending hymn Ut queant laxis by Paulus Deacon.

senses.d: A syllable used in sol-fa (solfège) to represent the third note of a major scale.

grp.label: third note of a major scale

es:mi.gl: mu; the Greek letter Μ, μ

ety.text: From Latin mi(ra) in the hymn for St. John the Baptist.
